entries.body: It would be great for all those wallets to adopt a locally verified simulation like this one. The problem I see is that it doesn’t protect against red-pill attacks. To make it more robust, the simulated outcomes should be enforced onchain, as MetaMask already does with its enforced simulations. But MetaMask’s version relies on its own centralized server and a limited contract that only checks balance changes on its smart accounts. Assertions.eth (my initiative) can assert any outcome onchain, so combining it with colibri’s verified simulation would give you both: a simulation you don’t have to trust, and an outcome that’s guaranteed. It would be great to see the wallets in this proposal adopt that combination.
